rules: Raw index name, election, district and party cells remain separate from corrections and returned ballot names.
Blank party cells carry the prior printed party for that candidate; later caucus notes do not change party at election.
Blank district cells are filled only when independently supported by a district return.
Bare years are general elections; full dates and year-plus-district codes are by-elections. A preceding By-Election heading cannot contaminate the next bare-year row.
The three 2001 rows in the later supplement support subsequent affiliation notes, not additional elections.
Collins and Farrell-Collins duplicate one 2001 elected event. Steves 1991 was defeated and is excluded. Bowbrick 1996 is restored from the return.
All genuine general-election records match same-book district returns; six seat totals and party totals match official summaries.
No cross-year person identifier, automatic-import approval or tenure boundary follows from this review.
resolved_printed_anomalies: Mike de Jong 1994: index uses 4 February nomination day; poll was 17 February.
Val Roddick 1999: index uses 24 November nomination day; poll was 7 December.
Spencer Herbert: 2008 Vancouver-Burrard and 2009 Vancouver-West End labels reversed; alias text is not a candidate name.
Ben Stewart: elected 14 May 2013, resigned 11 June; Christy Clark won the distinct 10 July by-election.
Bowbrick omitted, Steves wrongly included, Coleman district blank and Collins duplicated.
Jackson NPD corrected to NDP; Warnke, Orcherton, Mayencourt, Holman and Simons district defects corrected from returns.
remaining_review: Cross-year person IDs and name-form changes require integration review. Index and returned ballot names are both retained.
Unresolved district spelling differences remain in district_text_review, including typos in the return tables themselves.

Caucus/service notes remain transcription evidence, not independently corroborated tenure boundaries. Dalton note prints an inconsistent 11 January 2000 after a July 2000 return; not silently corrected.
Validation combines structural checks, targeted visual inspection and same-book cross-checks; not every individual cell was visually inspected.
